pages.title: 5′ cap of mRNA

concepts.label: Cap functions
concepts.detail: The cap protects mRNA from ribonucleases and helps mRNA bind ribosomes.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

concepts.label: Cap linkage and early formation
concepts.detail: 7-methylguanosine has a 5′-5′ triphosphate linkage; cap is added after 20-30 nucleotides; S-adenosyl Methionine is methyl donor.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Chemical diagram checked against text: 7-methyl guanosine and reversed triphosphate linkage; two optional OCH3 groups at ribose 2′ positions; red yeast/vertebrate annotation retained without extending its scope.

uncertainties.description: The prose says additional methyl groups at C-2, whereas the figure identifies downstream ribose 2′ positions. Preserve both; do not score the ambiguous carbon-position wording.
The yeast/vertebrate note is positioned beside optional ribose methylation but has no explicit sentence defining its scope; do not generalize it to all capping.

pages.title: Polyadenylation

concepts.label: Polyadenylation signal and chemistry
concepts.detail: AAUAAA-associated cleavage 10-30 nucleotides downstream leaves RNA primer; polyadenylate polymerase adds 80-250 A residues without template.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: All figure labels and reaction direction checked; distinct endonuclease cleavage and polymerase addition stages retained. Do not treat all processing events as strictly sequential beyond this displayed reaction.

pages.title: RNA splicing: four groups/classes

concepts.label: Splicing class comparison
concepts.detail: Groups I/II self splice; group I uses guanosine, group II mitochondrial mRNA; group III nuclear mRNA spliceosome with U1/U2/U4/U5/U6; group IV tRNA described as protein-enzyme dependent.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Text and layout visually checked; no additional unlabeled teaching relationship inferred.

uncertainties.description: Group I nuclear/mitochondrial/rRNA/mRNA/tRNA list does not give a precise one-to-one location/substrate mapping. Do not score a more specific mapping than supplied.

Group IV is called the only protein-enzyme-spliced class here; page 12 also labels RNase P a ribozyme for tRNA end processing. Distinguish intron splicing from end processing; do not turn the broad wording into an exclusion of ribozymes from all tRNA processing.

pages.title: RNA splicing: Group I introns

concepts.label: Group I splicing nucleophiles
concepts.detail: External guanosine 3′ OH attacks the 5′ splice site; then 5′ exon 3′ OH attacks to join exons and release intron.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Image mechanism read in full, including primary transcript, intermediate, spliced RNA, two nucleophile captions and terminal labels. Source cofactor notation retained without changing its listed alternatives.

pages.title: Transesterification reaction

concepts.label: Splicing transesterification
concepts.detail: A new phosphodiester bond replaces an old one when guanosine 3′ OH acts as nucleophile.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Chemical bond-exchange diagram checked: exon/intron identity and free exon OH versus guanosine-linked intron are explicit.

pages.title: RNA splicing: Group II introns

concepts.label: Group II lariat and nucleophiles
concepts.detail: Intron adenosine 2′ OH initiates lariat formation; exon 3′ OH completes ligation; lariat branch is 2′,5′ phosphodiester.
concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Enlarged image reviewed; both nucleophile captions, branch bond inset, three-bond adenosine annotation and caption preserved.

concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

concepts.rationale: Core relationship, mechanism, or comparison explicitly taught on this page.

pages.visualNotes: Full-size image checked, including GU/A/AG labels, ATP annotations, inactive/active complexes, expelled U1/U4, lariat and intron-release stages; right-hand coordination figure checked separately.
